observations.detail: Material remediation centralizes import reconciliation temporal promotion in reconcileImportedTransactionForContext and routes both deterministic and direct-transfer reconciliation through it.
A planned target with occurredOn, plannedOn and imported cash date deliberately different becomes reconciled with imported date in effectiveOn while occurredOn and plannedOn are preserved.
A posted target with an older effectiveOn is reconciled using the imported source date, proving source cash date confirmation without rewriting economic or planned dates.
An already reconciled target is returned unchanged and performs no SQL mutation.
Both deterministic reconciliation and canonical transfer reconciliation invoke the same temporal promotion helper instead of issuing direct status-only SQL.
Existing Statement contract continues to use effectiveOn -> plannedOn -> occurredOn and excludes transactions without effectiveOn from effective cash balance.
Existing realized report control continues to assign posted/reconciled income and expense by occurredOn.
Canonical transaction date documentation remains unchanged and consistent with the remediation.
Generic TEMP-TRANSITION-PARITY-001 prevention/detection rule passed genericity validation, contract validation and two synthetic transfer tests.
At the single observe-only snapshot for the material head, CI run 32090251939 and Statement visual validation run 32090252002 were in_progress; no polling, rerun or dispatch was performed.

limitations: No local SolverFin checkout was available because github.com DNS resolution failed; executable repository CI was observed once and was still in progress at the material snapshot.
